name: Kridhan Infra Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2006, Kridhan Infra 
Ltd is in the business of trading in 
iron and steel and allied materials[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
KIL provides mechanical splicing (couplers) and threading solutions in India. It is engaged in the manufacturing of concrete piles & cast-in-place, 
couplers, and ready-made steel bars and services include bored piling, driven piling; micro piling; soil improvement, and soil  investigation.

pros: Debtor days have improved from 219 to 70.7 days.
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -32.9% over past five years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.5.62 Cr.
